# capture.txt records where every fixture in this directory came from.
#
# None of these files is hand-written. Each one is a page Facebook really served,
# captured with `fb archive` and gzipped, and this file is what makes that
# checkable: a fixture nobody can recapture is a fixture nobody can update when
# the page changes. TestEveryFixtureHasACaptureCommand fails if a .html.gz here
# has no row.
#
# Recapture one with the command in its row and gzip the page.html that
# `fb archive` writes:
#
#	fb archive nasa --dir /tmp/cap
#	gzip -9 -c /tmp/cap/page.html > fb/testdata/page_nasa.html.gz
#	go test ./fb -run Golden -update
#
# Then read the golden diff before committing it. A recapture that changes a
# record is either Facebook changing the page or the parser reading it
# differently, and the diff is the only place that difference is visible.
#
# Every page here was fetched signed out, on 2026-07-29, so what they hold is
# what Tier 0 sees and nothing more. Columns are name, date, command.

dir_blocked	2026-07-29	fb archive 'https://www.facebook.com/directory/pages/A'
